title: Instant Transfer Fee on Claim Money — Pocketwire Personal Account
content:
**1. Transfer amount.** For a customer who asks to have the money reimbursed on a claim sent instantly to a linked debit card, the transfer amount is the most recent claim reimbursement credited to the Pocketwire Personal Account, sent as one instant cash-out whose instant transfer fee is booked as a separate fee entry pointing to it. The most recent claim reimbursement is the claim reimbursement credit with the latest date on the account.

**2. Free quota.** The instant transfer fee is 0.00 when the transfer falls inside the free quota, which is the plan's fee-free instant cash-outs increased by the plan's card-holder bonus when the customer holds a Pocketwire debit card in active or locked status; the transfer falls inside the quota when the instant cash-outs dated in the last month, less those returned in that month (a return carries the speed of the transfer it returns), are fewer than that quota, a transfer counting in the last month when it is dated later than the same calendar day one month before the handling date.

**3. Fee outside the quota.** Outside the quota, the instant transfer fee is the transfer amount times the instant fee rate, which is the plan's instant transfer fee rate, raised to the plan's minimum fee when lower and lowered to the plan's maximum fee when higher, and rounded to the cent (half up) once, at the end.

**4. Rate and fee assembly.** Whatever rate tier applies, the instant fee rate is that tier less any rate cut, each cut being 0 where it does not apply, the cuts subtracted from the tier together, and the rate is never set below 0.25 percent. A percentage reduction of the fee, where one applies, is taken off the fee after the minimum and maximum have been applied and before the single rounding.

### Worked figures (hypothetical plan figures: 1 fee-free instant cash-out, a card-holder bonus of 1, a rate of 1.50 percent, a minimum fee of 0.25 and a maximum fee of 20.00)

**Quota**

| Debit card in active or locked status | Instant cash-outs in the last month | Returns of instant cash-outs in that month | Counted | Quota | Fee |
|---|---|---|---|---|---|
| Yes | 1 | 0 | 1 | 2 | 0.00 |
| Yes | 3 | 1 | 2 | 2 | Charged — 2 is not fewer than 2 |
| No | 1 | 0 | 1 | 1 | Charged |

**Fee outside the quota**

| Transfer amount | Amount times 1.50 percent | Fee |
|---|---|---|
| 612.40 | 9.186 | 9.19 |
| 10.00 | 0.15 | Raised to 0.25 |
| 2000.00 | 30.00 | Lowered to 20.00 |

A rate tier of 0.50 percent less rate cuts of 0.35 percentage points together would give 0.15 percent, so the rate is set at 0.25 percent. A fee of 20.00 after the maximum, with a 10 percent reduction, is 18.00; a transfer of 333.33 at 1.50 percent gives 4.99995, and a 10 percent reduction of that gives 4.499955, rounded once to 4.50.
